title: nisse research strategy config
description: The format of research/configs/<name>.json. This file documents the format; the check CI runs is nisse-proposal-check (crates/eval/src/proposal.rs), which also validates `strategy` with the engine's own parser.

name.description: Equal to the file name without .json.

family.description: The strategy line; the change budget is per family.

parent.description: The name of the config this changes, or null for the first of a family.

strategy.description: Strategy parameters, as nisse_engine::strategies::build takes them.

rationale.description: research/notes/<name>.md, with the three required headings.
